avis.texte: Have used this product for years now and always get compliments on my skin. I really attribute my clear skin to this and its great for anti-aging too. I feel its helping to prevent aging skin on me 100%. Highly recommend :)

I'm 60 years old and have used thus cleanser for more than a decade. I have somewhat sensitive skin. This cleanser is pricey but goes a long way. I only use it at night. My skin is clean, not stripped, and prepped for serum and moisturizer before bed. I look much younger than my age and feel this cleanser has helped me keep my skin that way!

avis.titre: Made Skin flaky, red and itchy
avis.texte: I am in my early 50's and felt like I needed something more exfoliating and moisturizing in a face cleanser. I used this Skin Resurfacing product 10 years ago so thought I would try it again. This product is not for me any more! I used this 2 times a day for 2-3 days and my skin was itchy and red. I reduced to using once a day for another two days and my skin was flaky and still irritated. I don't dare use it again as it has only been about 5 days since I stopped. But my skin improved about a day or 2 after I stopped.

avis.titre: The BEST anti-aging cleanser I've used this far!
avis.texte: I really love this cleanser because it exfoliates gently and effectively. My skin feels less congested and it's less dull. I noticed that I can go longer without getting facials compared to before when I didn't use this product. The only downside is the lack of makeup removal power. Due to its chemical profile, you can't use it to remove eye makeup, so I usually use Dermalogica Precleanse first. If you're worried about fine lines and dull skin, then look no further than this cleanser. You'll save money on facials and scrubs.

Love Love Love this face wash. It not to harsh, but it does well to keep my face free from blemishes. It helps to reduce redness and it helps to minimize the pores on my nose which I adore! I would recommend this to middle aged woman who wants pore shrinkage with very little to no blemishes

I have been using this cleanser for the last 10 years and I will continue to use it as long as they make it. I'm an esthetician and I started using it when I was in school. It completely cleared my underlying congestion and keeps my skin smooth and radiant. 10 out of 10!
This is my favorite all-time miracle cleanser, it does a great job removing make up and sunscreen, and makes my skin soft
Consistency is a must for this product. I apply it twice a day. The base is a creamy white cleaner. I've noticed that with consistent use my skin is more evenly toned.
I love the creamy texture. I use this as part of my double cleansing
Love it! I love the way it makes my face feel clean and refreshing. I also love the way it smells!

This cleanser is amazing! Super creamy with a light lather, it leaves my skin feeling smooth and fresh. It took a couple of weeks of using it every other night for my skin to adjust, but the results are definitely worth it!
This product cleans without drying my skin. The foam is rich and rinses easy.

I wanted to love this (mostly due to the price) but my skin reacted horribly. I have dry patches all over my face. I bought it to help with clogged pores. Id recommend it to someone with oily skin, maybe?

Used this face cleanser for 4 days and my face, neck, and lips are dried out. My skin is literally drinking up my cerave healing ointment. I have hives all over my face and neck. I'm in my mid 30s and wanted to get a kick start on an anti aging regime. I don't typically have dry or sensitive skin so be careful.

I have very sensitive skin, and this is the lightest formula for this type of cleanser. My skin felt amazing, but after one wash I had a horrible burn reaction. Tried it again a month later, sadly the same effect. So, be careful with washes like this. All depends on your beginning thpe.

I am 27 and am having issues with some lines on my forehead and skin texture. Ive used it tight and my lines are GONE from my forehead. After using this my skin feels nice and tight, and the glow is unreal. 10/10 worth every penny!

I just used this for the first time and it is awesome!! With the expert advice from my esthetican to use this with the daily exfoliant and it's the best combination. The larger with both feels great!! Excellent product
Very pleased with cleanser. I have sensitive skin and I haven't experienced any irritation. I have dull skin around my chin and so far I feel this cleanser is helping.
Very effective, powerful resurfacing cleanser. I did though, have to use it only a couple of times a week as it was mildly irritating daily.
This is my go to facial cleanser, I use it everyday and notice a brightness and smoothness to my face.
My granddaughter loves these products. She is always so happy when I gift them to her
This is my first time using this product. After 2 week of using it, I love it so far. I purchased it because of scars.

This has irritated and burned my skin under my eyes after only using for 2 days. I am disappointed that the instructions advised to use twice a day but after I come to the reviews, I see recommendations to start every other day. I discontinued use and washed my face with pre cleanser and an alternate wash tonight and my face is on fire.
Amazing product! Gives a little tingle but it's pleasant. I don't have any scars but I had Milia on my face which have almost disappeared from using this product. Price range suits my budget, too.
I love the Lactic Acid Cleanser as the 2nd step of my cleansing process. I don't feel too dry afterwards.
My skin feels smoother and not dry, especially during the winter months.

I haven't noticed any spots lighter on my face yet, but I have not been using it a very long time. I apply it usually three times a week. Mainly at night. It's a good balance with all the other products I ordered.
This product has made my skin look younger and wrinkles less noticeable. Love it.

This cleanser is good for duo cleanse the skin once or twice a week. This kit really works to double cleanse the skin. Beginning of use this product, I used it everyday at least month . Because of that I get scars on the left side of my face, that's makes me still upset.
I love the way my skin feels after using this cleanser! I was super excited to try it!
I love the way this cleanser makes my skin feel polished smooth.
I LOVE the skin resurfacing cleanser. It smells amazing, leaves my skin feeling great and it is very affordable <3
I love all my Dermalogica products. I love when people ask me if I get fillers and I say it's all Dermalogica.
After using a few days my face is dry, red and itchy. I think the product was too harsh, although my skin isn't sensitive.

I have been using this phenomenal cleanser for several years - it is gentle on my skin, yet cleanses better than any cleansing product I have previously used. My skin truly looks good at 61 and I believe it begins with this product.
This is my first time using this product and I'm happy with it. The lather is nice and leaves my face smooth and clean. I would recommend this cleanser.
Really like this produce and will buy again. Skin feels smooth and radiant.
I love the dermalogica brand. But this cleanser has made my skin dry and break out. Like a skin reaction. Am I doing it wrong? Lol.

I'm low-maintenance when it comes to skincare and makeup; but, as I get (ahem) older, I want to keep looking my best. I use the Age Smart Daily Superfoliant three times/week, and the Skin Resurfacing Lactic Acid Cleanser every day. It's gentle but smoothing, totally not "smelly," and I feel super clean.
Love this product. Leaves skin feeling smooth, soft and clean. Also love the smell. I have not used long enough to see if it helps with scars.
This is a great cleanser. The lactic acid works well without being too harsh on my sensitive skin.
Easy to use. Last a long time as you really don't need a ton of it to get your skin clean
This is by far one of my favorite products from Dermalogica. It was recommended to me by my esthetician and I haven't looked back since.

Loving it so far, feels very creamy when applying. It is making my skin a bit more sensitive so I would suggest easing into it. It does make my face feel clean and seems to be brightening some of my acne spots

I am using this along with the thermafoliant and they work great together. It's helping get rid of the gunk on my skin..layers of build up. It's making my skin look cleaner and lighter and it's helping my scars lighten. I highly recommend this product.
I have consistently used this product especially due to hormonal issues experienced in my mid thirties. Mid forty's now and I still love it.

So ive been using this now for about 6/7 months and my skin is very clear! I use this and i alternate with the urban skinrx srub. I leave this cleanser on my face like a mask while i wash in the shower and when i rinse my face is SUPER SOFT. I will say though it can sting a little lol. I dont have sensitive slin but for someone who does maybe not this cleanser.

I've been struggling for acne for about a year or two and everything I tried didn't work. This cleanser was recommended to my by a friend and I had this for about two weeks and it has cleared up my skin!!!!! I truly recommend this for people that have tried everything and couldn't find anything that's work for now.

I'm a long-time dermalogica user who has tried dozens of products recommended by an esthetician. I'm 29 years old with redness, dehydration, oiliness, enlarged pores, and bumpy texture. I was at a different store than usual and had this product recommended to me by an esthetician who hasn't treated my skin before. I used this product once and ended up with a splotchy red rash along my jawline and eyes. I thought it had to be something else, so I waited for two weeks until it cleared up and tried again. Sure enough the rash came back. I still love dermalogica, but this product just isn't for me. p.s. don't forget as long as the product is at least half full and within 60 days of purchase, you can return or exchange it if you bought it at Ulta!

avis.titre: I'd be heartbroken if ever discontinued!
avis.texte: I've never used a better face wash in my life! Combined with Precleanse before and you've got the best double cleanse combo. It gets your skin super clean while also softening and peeling back dead skin. Amazing stuff. I use it daily!
Great cleanser - creamy but with light exfoliation. Been using for years - great stuff :)
This product provides the important base for my skin care. I notice the difference immediately if I miss using this skin cleanser. My skin feels rougher, moisturisers aren't absorbed as well.

After doing the whole routine for a few days I noticed some redness and swelling under my eyes and alot of flaky crackly skin on my face. I have stopped currently to let my skin heal andcwill try again once cleared up. Feel like twice a day is too much for my skin maybe. It's been 3 days and finally swelling down and redness going away.
Keeps my skin smooth, bright, and refreshed. Gently polishes.
My face feels amazing after I wash. No dryness or tightness at all!
The cleanser giving my face with a glow and polish skin. It has a power to diminish my pores and small lines around my mouth.

I recently switched from Murad (used for over a decade) to Dermalogica and I love my new skincare routine. I can already see the difference and feel the difference and I couldn't be happier. I will be using Dermalogica for the rest of my life (I'm old but whateverâ€¦ what I'm saying is I will never have to research another skincare product line again because this is it).
This has been a quality staple in my daily cleaning routine for years, and my skin looks fabulous for it. I never have break outs, and it leaves my skin is smooth, polished and radiant.
I have combination skin and this drys my face out a lot, even after just 1 use. I would only recommend to someone with very oily skin.
I've been using this cleanser for quite awhile. My skin feels clean and smooth and hydrated. Love it!
Must have for aging skin, making skin hydrated, soft, glowing.
Perfect cleanser but only concern is using sun protection is compulsory
I love how smooth my skin is feeling. The fine lines around my eyes have minimized.
I've been using this for about 14 years now. Love the smell and it leaves the skin nice and smooth. I only use it about every other day as my skin is on the drier side.

Love this cleanser for years. Not only at home but on my clients face during facial treatments. It's creamy, hydrating, exfoliating, tingles, base is thick, and great quality. I only use 1-3x a week because it's potent.
I got it for my mom and she loved it it helped her to clean all the make up out and leave the skin fresh
Love this creamy face cleanser. The scent is pretty and light. Not drying. Skin feels moisturized after using.
I like it as it helps in clearing and my skin looks good. A little dying outside either side of mouth. I would rate it 4 1/2 stars.
My favorite Dermalogica cleanser! I've been using this for quite some time now (about 3 years). Cleans my skin without making it feel dried out.
I've used dermalogica for years . There cleansers are the best .
Love this product. It smooths the appearance of fine lines and evens out the texture.
This was a new purchase for me and I love it. My face is smooth and the fine lines are disappearing.
Leaves skin feeling soft and hydrated, pleasant and light scent
Love the anti aging cleanser. I also us the precleanse love the two together.
Love this stuff! Really polishes the skin and helps reduce dark spots.

avis.titre: There is no better better cleanser for me!
avis.texte: I have used this cleanser for years, and still love it! It is the only product that thoroughly cleans my skin and keeps it smooth. I have tried other products over the years, because, honestly, this is a little pricey - but I always come back to this.

I have used Dermalogica products for over 30 years, strayed from time to time, but have always come back. This cleanser brightens my skin and leaves it feeling smooth and clean. It is the perfect pick-me-up for my face

I started to use this cleanser after it was recommended by my esthetician. This cleanser is ThE BEST. It makes my face feel clean and my skin looks amazing. After using a particular cleanser for many, many years â€" I made the switch, and with this Dermalogica cleanser is where I'll stay! I'm hooked.
Love this cleanser! Gentle yet effective on my aging combination skin. My skin tone has evened out over the months of using this cleanser and feels much clearer
